tasks.title: Bind builtin converter and overlay provenance
tasks.goal: Prove transformed returned bytes using existing pure conversion.
steps: Run only pure builtin conversion over verified capture bytes in memory.
Bind descriptor, converter recipe, authorized overlay and source-output map.
Compare materialized output before assigning derivation-proven; expose carriers reusable by later M-10.
Preserve source-neutral stem/anchor locator and canonical SpecDoc IR content hash across equivalent Markdown/XML materializations; version schema rather than reinterpret existing specmap fields.
positive_cases: Declared Vibe XML has a named converter and exact output proof.
Equivalent Markdown/XML forms retain the same canonical node hash; query-time locator resolves the actual installed slot extension and line range.
negative_cases: Converter/overlay/output drift refuses; native conversion never runs implicitly.
Source-only line/path and raw-byte hash are never presented as a materialized slot location or cross-form semantic drift.

tasks.title: Report failed source conversion at install
tasks.goal: Make failed Markdown-to-XML conversion observable, recorded and optionally fatal while preserving default install availability.
steps: Distinguish ordinary copied files from Markdown spec files whose requested XML conversion failed; retain the structured parser error and source path.
Default install prints one warning per failed conversion, records a versioned copied-unconverted disposition and reason in the slot record, and completes without a silent success.
Add strict-conversion install input that refuses the failed conversion before publishing a new slot; make consumer vibe check report the recorded issue.
Show converted and copied-unconverted counts in closure diff, with exact scope and no double counting.
positive_cases: Valid Markdown converts to XML; invalid stranded status remains Markdown with visible diagnostic and typed slot record in default mode.
Closure diff counts converted and copied-unconverted source files for the applied slot.
negative_cases: Strict conversion leaves previous lock/slot state intact; malformed reason or disposition is rejected by slot-record validation.
Unrelated ordinary Markdown copy is not mislabeled as a failed conversion.
